sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsels for the State as well as Informant in ABLAPL No.8713 of 2025.

5. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T Case No.525 of 2025 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M, Phulbani, arising out of Phiringia P.S. Case No.105 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/323/294/506/34 IPC read with Sections 4/6 of the POCSO Act.

6. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner in ABLAPL No.8713 of 2025 that taking into account the nature of allegations and since charge sheet has already been filed, custodial interrogation of the Petitioner is not warranted.
Hence, the Petitioner may be protected by pre-arrest bail.

7. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner in ABLAPL No.6510 of 2025 the allegations so far as the present Petitioner is concerned is at par with his wife who was directed to be released on bail vide order dated 14.07.2025 in ABLAPL No.6510 of 2025.
Hence, on the ground of parity the Petitioner seeks release.
8. Learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel appearing for Informant in ABLAPL No.8713 of 2025 oppose the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

9. This Court perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of BNSS.
10.
Taking note of the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the application for pre-arrest bail.
However, it is directed that the Petitioners may surrender before the learned S.D.J.M, Phulbani in connection with the aforementioned case within one month from today.

In the event of their surrender and motion for bail, the same be considered by the learned S.D.J.M,
Phulbani on merits, in the first hour of the day.
In the event of rejection of the prayer for bail by the learned S.D.J.M, Phulbani, the Petitioners are at liberty to move the higher forum for bail in the second hour on the same day.
11. On being so moved, the higher forum is requested to make an endeavor to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioners on the same day.

The case diary shall be made available to the concerned courts to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioners and learned S.D.J.M, Phulbani is called upon to transmit the case record to the higher forum in the second hour expeditiously in the event of rejection of the bail application by him.
Ground of parity, if any, may be considered by the learned court(s) below.
12. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
